name.en-US: A Complete Catechism of the Catholic Religion

description.en-US: Fr Joseph Deharbe's Catholic catechism in John Fander's English: a short history of revealed religion from the Creation to the present time, then the catechism proper in numbered questions and answers with scriptural proofs and applications, on Faith (the Creed), the Commandments of God and of the Church, and the Means of Grace (the sacraments and prayer). Sixth American edition, conformed to the Code of Canon Law (1912-1924).
description.pt-BR: O catecismo católico do Pe. Joseph Deharbe na tradução inglesa de John Fander: uma breve história da religião revelada, da Criação até hoje, e depois o catecismo propriamente dito em perguntas e respostas numeradas com provas da Escritura e aplicações, sobre a Fé (o Credo), os mandamentos de Deus e da Igreja e os meios da graça (os sacramentos e a oração). Sexta edição americana, conforme ao Código de Direito Canônico (1912-1924).

en-US.editor: James J. Fox and Thomas McMillan

sources.description: A Complete Catechism of the Catholic Religion, trans. John Fander, sixth American edition, conformed to the Codex Juris Canonici, ed. James J. Fox and Thomas McMillan (New York: Schwartz, Kirwin & Fauss; copyrights 1912, 1919, 1924), via the archive.org OCR text. Tier A: public domain in the United States (printing of 1924 or earlier). The OCR is uncorrected beyond systematic fixes (running heads, hyphenation, 'Re-' misread as 'Ee-'); the table of Roman pontiffs and the abbreviation list were left out.
